purpose: Secure one-to-one alignment of current inventory 145 against the released 1991 printed Kenen continuation; conservative release-deduplication evidence.

method.normalization: lowercase Cyrillic letters only; punctuation and spacing removed; Kyrgyz letters preserved
method.candidate_similarity: Python difflib.SequenceMatcher ratio over normalized line strings
method.ordering: strictly increasing one-to-one manuscript/printed sequence alignment
method.acceptance: high textual similarity with neighboring ordered support; lower-scoring variants only when flanked on both sides by close ordered counterparts; opening line accepted by direct episode-boundary/context verification
method.exclusion: isolated exact or fuzzy stock phrases outside the anchored sequence are not mappings

manuscript_only_relative_to_print.interpretation: These physical manuscript rows have no accepted one-to-one counterpart in the anchored printed window. They are manuscript-only relative to this printed witness (largely print abridgement, with some textual variation); this does not assert global uniqueness against every other witness.

excluded_candidate_zone.reason: The manuscript is in the pre-birth battle episode while the printed continuation places an aggressively abridged/redacted form later in its editorial order. Candidate matches are isolated or stock-formula-like and do not establish secure one-to-one sequence positions.
